The incident has led to multiple injuries, prompting a significant emergency response from local law enforcement. Authorities are on the scene, and they have requested a medical flight to assist with transporting the injured.

This incident is raising serious concerns in the community. Large police presence indicates the severity of the situation, as officers work diligently to ensure public safety. Reports suggest that the shooter is still active, which has heightened the urgency of the response. Residents in the vicinity are advised to stay indoors and avoid the area as law enforcement conducts their operations. For continuous updates, you can follow the latest news on Twitter.
